title: AZ-900 · Describe the core architectural components of Azure · Describe Azure management infrastructure

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe the core architectural components of Azure
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure management infrastructure
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure resource?

options.text: The worldwide infrastructure that enables Azure services to be deployed close to users and across regions
A physically separate datacenter location within an Azure region with independent power, cooling, and networking
The basic Azure object that you create, provision, or deploy, such as a VM, database, or virtual network
A geographic area containing one or more nearby datacenters connected with low-latency networking

questions.explanation: Azure resource is the basic Azure object that you create, provision, or deploy, such as a VM, database, or virtual network.

questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Resource group refer to?

A scope above subscriptions used to apply governance and access across multiple subscriptions

questions.explanation: Resource group is a logical container in which every Azure resource belongs to exactly one group at a time.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe the core architectural components of Azure
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure management infrastructure
questions.question: Which description correctly matches Resource-group deletion?

options.text: The identity relationship used to access Azure and own one or more subscriptions

questions.explanation: Resource-group deletion is an operation that deletes the resources contained in that resource group.

questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.
